Title: UmbraDesktop Entertainment Add-on
Description: Games and media for UmbraDesktop. An optional add-on that puts Minesweeper, Snake, Solitaire and umbraCoffee on the desktop, each in a window of its own and themed along with the rest of it.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features.

RelatedPackages.Description: The desktop itself. This package is an add-on to it and installs it as a dependency; the desktop works on its own without the games.
Notepad, Paint, Sticky Notes, Calculator, Disk Cleanup and the rest of Windows' Accessories for the desktop. Independent of this package: install either, both or neither.

Screenshots.Caption: All three games at once, each in a window of its own under the Umbraco theme with its own button on the taskbar.
Minesweeper in a window of its own, under the Windows 98 theme. It arrives in the launcher's Games group and gets a taskbar button like any other app.
Snake, the second game, under the same theme. Arrow keys to steer, a score and a best score, and it pauses itself when its window loses focus.

Solitaire, the third game: Klondike with draw one or draw three, on a table and with card backs that follow the theme. The settings button in the top right corner sets the draw mode, card back and card faces.

The Arcade, which comes with the games: boards you lead, your top threes and colleagues playing, then a tile per game with your best beside the leader. Each game also shows your result and the leaderboard while you play.
umbraCoffee while a show is live: the stream with its own control bar, the episode's title, guest and summary under it, and the Chat and Episodes tabs beside it.
umbraCoffee before the next show: a countdown where the picture will be, the start time written like the desktop's clock, and the coming episode at the top of the list.
